imageConstraints: Use the same physical basin in every scene: 30 × 20 × 13 cm when expanded and 30 × 20 × 5 cm when collapsed, together with the real front/top camera references and the approved current tube reference.
Keep a moderately rectangular rounded 3:2 footprint. Screen pixel ratios vary with camera perspective; do not stretch one image axis to force a 3:2 screen bounding box.
Show a compact facial basin at believable scale against hands, head and counter. Avoid foreground perspective that makes it look like a large tub.
Keep both long-side handles, short-rim dips, two white folding bands, integrated blue base/grid and the permanently attached current twin tube with blue mouthpiece.

When collapsed, use the confirmed 30 × 20 cm footprint and 5 cm height; preserve the same mold, handles and permanently attached twin tube. Do not infer capacity or other measurements from either bounding box.
stateNote: The dimensions field describes the expanded state; collapsedDimensions describes the collapsed state. Both states were confirmed by the product owner on 2026-10-15.
